description: Guardian of two look-alike children says 'my son' without naming which one.
turns: Mere bete ke liye Dr. Sethi ke saath appointment chahiye.

expected.notes: Sunita is a valid guardian of BOTH Aarav and Arjun (same surname, DOB and phone). A naive agent books for the first ward it finds, or for Sunita herself. Authorised is not the same as unambiguous.
